The team will be AI-first in two meaningful ways: using AI to drive engineering productivity and strong engineering discipline, and building a product that applies AI in genuinely innovative ways to problems that matter. You'll have significant ownership over the QA process, documentation and tools in a startup-like setting. This role is for a hands-on, self-starter who thrives on balancing performance, cost, and reliability. Within your first 3 months, you will have live customers on the platform and a thriving, growing team behind it - directly accelerating how customers bring life-saving products to market.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Role We're hiring Senior Quality Engineers to join Veeva, building mission-critical software for the global Life Sciences industry across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices. As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you will drive functional and automated quality across cutting-edge, complex systems—ensuring high reliability and customer success with every release.

jobs.title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon
jobs.location_raw: United Kingdom - London · France - Paris · Massachusetts - Boston · Germany - Berlin · Canada - Toronto
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. In this role, you will bridge hands-on case processing execution with high-level strategic vision for the future of PV Operations, directly shaping next-generation AI and automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - English & Korean Speaking
jobs.location_raw: South Korea - Seoul · China - Dalian · China - Beijing
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Systems is looking for Senior Technical Consultants, who have strong technical and consulting background, and a passion for helping customers achieve their business vision, are wishing to participate in the transformation of the Life Sciences Industry and in addition are interested in learning all the details about Cloud System Management. Technical Consultants will work with regional and/or global service teams closely to build technical solutions including system integration to help deliver successful implementations. The Technical Consultants are members of our Professional Services (Consulting) Organization, providing Project and Post-Go-Live application consulting as a subject matter expert of Veeva Commercial and R&D Cloud products portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - R&D Cloud Solutions
jobs.description_text: The Role Shift your career from external consulting to vendor-side ownership. Go-live is only the baseline. Working directly for the software vendor means you own the long-term technical strategy and drive continuous platform evolution with direct access to the R&D engineers who write the code. In this strategic, advisory-led role, you will act as a Subject Matter Expert for Life Sciences leaders, ranging from emerging biotechs to global Top 20 Pharma. Focusing on either Veeva Clinical Operations or Veeva Regulatory,, you will lead complex platform architecture, drive legacy-to-cloud change management, and directly influence future product roadmaps from within our expanding CEE hub of 60+ consultants across Poland and Hungary supported by Veeva’s global network of 8,000+ professionals.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - China Clinical Operations
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva’s Solution Consultants are an integral part of our sales team, partnering with Market Strategies and Account Partners as product experts in the sales cycle. As a Solution Consultant for Clinical Operations, you will provide product and process expertise in the form of consultative discussions, demonstrations, tailored presentations, and conference room pilots with Veeva’s customers and prospects in China. This involves working to understand the clinical trial management and operational challenges of each customer, tailoring events to show how our Veeva Vault Clinical Suite (eTMF, CTMS, Study Training, Payment, Site Connect etc) meets those needs, articulating complex technical and regulatory concepts clearly, and effectively addressing customer questions and concerns.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - Commercial Basics
jobs.location_raw: Massachusetts - Boston · Pennsylvania - Radnor · California - Pleasanton
jobs.description_text: The Role As a Solution Consultant on the Veeva Commercial Basics team, you'll be the technical and storytelling engine behind our sales cycle—translating the power of our pre-configured Vault applications into clear, compelling value for emerging biotech customers. You'll lead product demonstrations, build presentations and demo videos, and partner closely with our Product team to shape where Commercial Basics goes next.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - LIMS - CPG & F&B
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Systems has built the first modern cloud LIMS system, and we are hiring a Solution Consultant, LIMS for the Food & Beverage (F&B) and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industries, to confidently demonstrate its power and value to our global enterprise customers. This exciting, high-impact role sits at the true intersection of business and technology within the QC Lab, placing you at the forefront of LIMS and Quality Platforms. As a vital member of the Veeva QualityOne Solution Consulting team, you will partner closely with our Strategy and Sales organizations to drive the sales process. Your primary focus will be leading customer-centric, value-driven demonstrations of Veeva LIMS within the Vault Quality Suite. Beyond LIMS, you will have the unique opportunity to expand your expertise by learning and presenting Veeva’s broader Quality Cloud solutions, including Veeva QMS, Veeva QualityDocs, and Veeva Training. This is an unparalleled opportunity to build cutting-edge skills with a first-of-its-kind application while shaping the lab of the future. At Veeva, you will collaborate with a passionate, growing team in an environment fiercely dedicated to employee and customer success.

jobs.title: Team Lead Operations - OpenData - India
jobs.description_text: The Role Reporting to the Director, Product – OpenData, India, the Team LeadOperations – OpenData India will manage and support the Data Stewardship team responsible for maintaining the quality of the India OpenData offering within the APAC region. In addition to leading the team, you will also perform Data Steward responsibilities, including researching and updating healthcare provider and organization records, contacting hospitals and group practices to verify information, and maintaining accurate provider affiliation data. If you are passionate about data quality, process excellence, and team leadership, this is an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact. This role is based at Veeva's Mumbai office. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

jobs.title: Technical Consultant - Front-end Development
jobs.location_raw: Washington - DC · New Jersey - Princeton · North Carolina - Raleigh
jobs.description_text: The Role Are you a creative front-end developer looking for a company to grow with? Do you have a passion for crafting top-quality code, but you have an equal passion for talking about it? Do you enjoy having the power of being a hands-on software developer, but the flexibility and face-time of a consultant? If so, we would love to talk to you! Our Technical Services Team is growing to meet the needs of our ever- growing customer base. Vault CRM is the premier cloud-based CRM system used by the Life Sciences Industry, built on the Veeva Vault platform. Technical Architects like you will help craft unique user experiences with CRM X-Pages. Come grow with us. This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. This is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Support Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Role Level up your career with Veeva RTSM! Join our scaling team as a Technical Operations Support Engineer and help power our world-class IRT/RTSM platform. In this fast-paced hybrid role, you’ll sit at the intersection of Systems Administration, DevOps, and Tier 3 Technical Support, driving AWS migrations, optimizing operational workflows, and solving complex architecture challenges. If you're an ambitious engineer ready for startup style energy backed by a stable, growing public company, this is your opportunity to drive immediate impact and scale your career.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (AI) - Vault Medical
jobs.description_text: The Role Make the work of our customers delivering life-changing medicines and treatments to patients more efficient and productive. We are looking for an experienced technical product manager to design and deliver high-value AI Agent solutions for Vault Medical. In this role, you will be the expert in leveraging AI to automate the content lifecycle, from speeding up the Medical review process to automating scientific literature publishing to automating the generation of medical information responses. You will build AI agents that help medical affairs teams accelerate speed-to-market for critical health communications while ensuring compliance.

You will operate with speed, focus, and a high level of individual accountability—embodying our core values of Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed.

jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for an innovative University Recruiter based in Poland to shape and execute our talent attraction strategy for our Services team. We welcome candidates from non-traditional recruiting backgrounds—such as tech sales, field marketing, or technical customer-facing roles—who bring a strong business mindset, proactive communication, and a passion for building high-performing teams. You will collaborate deeply with hiring managers, build market visibility, and deliver high-caliber talent aligned with our product evolution, tech-enabled tools, and long-term operating vision.

jobs.title: Validation Analyst - RTSM
jobs.location_raw: South Korea - Busan · South Korea - Seoul
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Computer Software Validation (CSV) professional with a specialty in clinical trial software. This role would give you the opportunity to work on a leading solution in Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) software. To excel in this role, you will require strong technical writing capabilities and the ability to simplify complex topics. As a member of the RTSM team, you will work closely with Development and Project Management teams to support customer RTSM implementations in a dynamic environment. You will use your expertise to take ownership of the validation process for assigned projects and play an important role in building and maintaining product excellence for the RTSM system.

jobs.title: Vice President of Marketing - Crossix
jobs.location_raw: Pennsylvania - Philadelphia · New York - New York City
jobs.description_text: The Role Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader. We are seeking a Vice President of Marketing to lead marketing for Crossix. In this role, you will shape how our market-leading Measurement and Audience products are positioned across a dynamic and competitive landscape. As a member of the Crossix leadership team, you will partner closely with leaders in Sales, Product, and Strategy, while leading a lean team of product and field marketing professionals.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, ML-based Controls
jobs.description_text: You Will… Design and develop data-driven and machine-learned approaches to vehicle control problems, bringing modern ML to a domain traditionally solved with classical methods. Develop learned models of vehicle behavior and dynamics, and integrate them into the closed-loop simulation. Apply machine learning to improve how the controller adapts across vehicles and operating conditions. Be part of a team of multidisciplinary Engineers and Research Scientists using an AI-first approach to enable safe self-driving at scale. Own problems end to end, from conceptualization and offline experimentation through simulation and on-vehicle validation. You'll join as the third product designer at Waabi, sitting on the Product, Design & TPM team. You'll be the systems-minded builder who turns one-off UI work into compounding returns across the whole platform. You will… Design data labeling and annotation workflows. You'll design the tools for data curation, internal lightweight labeling, QA, and the feedback loops that connect label quality to model performance. Today this work lives in many surfaces, and your goal will be to unify the workflows to accelerate training data throughput and quality, to continually improve autonomy safety at scale. jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer - Operational Readiness and Field Safety
jobs.description_text: To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. We are seeking a practical and decisive systems engineer to bridge the gap between our AI development and trucking operations. You will lead the definition of operational procedures, deep-dive investigations into field events, and inform when and where our autonomy is ready to deploy. You will... Lead Field Safety at Waabi by proactively establishing processes to escalate issues, reacting to any fleet issues in the field and owning Waabi's incident response. Define and conduct operational readiness testing for Waabi's autonomous vehicle operations and create the necessary evidence in the readiness framework. Work with operations and software teams to define protocols for nominal and off-nominal situations (e.g., severe weather response, sensor degradation, connectivity outages, and trip interruptions). Create processes for ongoing field safety monitoring and support the establishment of leading and lagging safety indicators and tooling needed. Analyze operational trends and past field events to drive systemic safety enhancements across both development and operations. Support the Operations team in developing and executing incident response training and operational preparedness activities. Interface with regulatory bodies and contribute to industry standards discussions around AV operational safety validation approaches. Qualifications: Undergrad in Robotics, Mechanical Engine

jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer - Safety Methodologies
jobs.description_text: To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. We are seeking a passionate and experienced safety or systems engineer to spearhead the development and implementation of critical safety framework methods that underpin our driverless autonomy readiness decisions. This is a unique opportunity to shape how Waabi quantitatively ensures and validates the safety of our autonomous trucking solution, working with our highly realistic simulator, real-world data, and cutting-edge generative AI techniques. You will play a pivotal role in creating the evidence for safe operation and leading efforts in a rapidly evolving and groundbreaking field. You will... Inform driverless release testing by developing sample-efficient, high-signal safety datasets across simulation and closed-course track testing. Establish and manage a robust feedback loop from on-road monitoring and safety relevant events to continuously expand and refine test coverage. Validate and optimize safety evaluation pipelines by conducting comparative analyses on core safety frameworks and benchmark criteria to continuously evolve our safety frameworks. Own the creation of clear and structured safety artifacts, ensuring all readiness decisions are transparent and fully traceable to validation evidence. Mentor peers by fostering a culture of technical excellence and driving clear, constructive collaboration between teams. Qualifications: Undergrad required; Masters or PhD

jobs.description_text: ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。 私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。 ========================================================================= チームについて Teammate Driving (POV BEV) チームは、自動運転システムにおける最も基本的な機能の1つである車線維持機能と、自動運転システムで使用される地図情報提供サービスを開発しています。テストエンジニアのミッションは、システム要件に基づいて実装されたソフトウェアの機能、性能、品質基準を設定し、評価し、設計者にフィードバックし、製品の性能と品質を向上させることです。また、これらの製品をトヨタの次世代運転支援システム「Toyota Safety Sense」と「Teammate」に実装し、世界中の顧客により安全な運転とより快適なモビリティを提供します。 求める人材 私たちは、ソフトウェアのパフォーマンスと品質を向上させるために、AD/ADAS車両評価の運用と問題分析を行い、問題解決を推進できるエンジニアを探しています。また、ソフトウェアエンジニア、テストドライバ、さまざまな協力者と良好な関係を築くために、新しい価値を提案し、効果的にコミュニケーションできる人材を求めています。尚、定期的に東京・日本橋のオフィスに出社し、静岡県東富士のテストコースで実地試験の実施が必要となります。 業務内容 プロジェクトの進捗状況に合わせた評価計画の策定と管理 システム要件を満たすテストシナリオの作成 実車でのテストと特定された問題の原因の特定 アジャイル開発における問題管理と解決の推進 必須条件 以下のスキルと経験が必要です。 ・技術 ・車両評価業務 ・ユーザー視点でソフトウェア要件が満たされていることを検証する能力 ・Gitによるソフトウェア管理能力 ・AD（自動運転）/ADAS（先進運転支援システム）に関する知識と各技術の相互作用の理解 ・管理 ・優れた問題解決能力、仮説検証能力、タスク管理能力 ・ドキュメンテーション能力 ・さまざまな情報を体系化し、首尾一貫した計画を立案する能力 ・言語 ・日常的な場面で使われる日本語を理解できる能力。（例：日本語能力試験N2以上、または同等のレベル）

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Go)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU You will play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact software solutions across our platform. You bring curiosity, initiative, and a passion for clean, scalable systems. You collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional partners to design, build, and improve our technical stack. You’re hands-on, deeply engaged in the code, and consistently seeking better ways to solve complex engineering challenges.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Backend Engineer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working alongside our HQ Integration Management and Engineering teams. Your job is to make partnerships technically real: turning an inbound partnerships inquiry into a working integration, generating and serving the affiliate and referral links that Traffic Source Partners use, and making sure the traffic those links carry lands correctly in our Web Shops and is attributed all the way through to a purchase. You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets. This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and strategic Customer Success Manager to join our team. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of high-value clients, ensuring their satisfaction, growth, and long-term retention. Acting as a trusted advisor, you’ll be the key point of contact between our customers and internal teams, driving product adoption, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring seamless execution of customer needs.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Customer Success Manager at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok. You will work side by side with our HQ and APAC Customer Success Managers, supporting the day-to-day success of the Traffic Source Partners we onboard — affiliates, media partners, creator networks, and publishers who drive players to the web shops we operate for game developers. The centre of gravity of this role is account management operations, and in particular partner payouts:making sure every partner is set up correctly, that their performance data is accurate, that their payout is calculated, documented, approved and paid on time, and that any discrepancy is chased down and closed. It is detailed work that partners feel immediately — getting it right is how trust in the programme gets built. This is an entry-level position with real ownership from day one. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply, provided you have the right attitude and eagerness to learn. If you are organised, comfortable with numbers, enjoy being the reliable person other teams can count on, and want to learn the commercial side of the games industry from the inside, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Japan
jobs.description_text: Digital Marketing Manager｜Job Description About You（求める人物像） 日本市場におけるデジタルマーケティング戦略の企画・実行をリードするポジションです。 Webサイト、SEO、コンテンツマーケティング、デジタル広告、メールマーケティング、マーケティングオートメーション、SNSなどのデジタルチャネルを活用し、ブランド認知の向上、リード獲得、顧客エンゲージメント、パイプライン創出につなげていきます。また、他チームと連携し、日本市場のビジネス目標に合わせた統合的なデジタルマーケティング施策を推進します。戦略立案だけでなく、キャンペーンの企画・実行、コンテンツ制作・管理、Hands-onで一貫して担当できる方を求めています。 ABOUT US（会社概要） Xsolla（エクソラ）は、ビデオゲーム業界が抱えるさまざまな課題を解決するために設計された、強力なツールとサービスを提供するグローバルなコマース企業です。インディーからAAAタイトルまで、あらゆる規模の開発会社が、資金調達、配信、マーケティング、マネタイズにおいてXsollaと提携しています。「ゲームの未来を信じる」という理念のもと、Xsollaは、ゲーム開発者により多くの機会とリソースを提供し続けることを使命としています。本社は米国カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルスにあり、商取引の記録管理を担う企業（Merchant of Record）として、これまでに1,500社以上のゲーム開発者が、より多くのプレイヤーにリーチし、ビジネスの成長を実現するサポートを行ってきました。Xsollaは、収益化の多様な選択肢と成功への道筋を提供し、開発者が“ゲームを楽しむ”ために必要なすべてを支援しています。詳しくはhttps://www.xsolla.com をご覧ください。

jobs.title: Frontend developer
jobs.description_text: Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for an Investment Analyst to join Xsolla Video Games Credit Fund. You’ll work across the full investment process, from sourcing and evaluating game studios to financial modeling, due diligence, deal execution and portfolio monitoring. The role offers direct exposure to game developers and publishers across the World, giving you a behind-the-scenes look at how games are developed, financed and brought to market. You’ll work closely with the investment team on real transactions from day one, develop expertise at the intersection of gaming and finance, and have plenty of room to grow as the fund expands.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for an IT Support Engineer who is customer-service oriented, proactive, and highly organized to join our Corporate IT team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own IT operations end-to-end for our Berlin office - from employee onboarding and equipment setup to managing our core internal systems and being the first point of contact for anyone who needs help. Strong troubleshooting and communication skills are essential, along with experience in IT support, systems administration, and hands-on hardware/software maintenance. The ability to manage multiple priorities independently and adapt to shifting demands in a dynamic environment will be key to your success in this role. If you're passionate about solving problems and keeping people productive and love being part of a global gaming commerce company that helps developers bring their games to players around the world, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Middle/Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Middle/Senior Backend Engineer who is passionate about building secure, high-load identity systems to join our Xsolla ID team . The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to develop a next-generation IAM (Identity and Access Management) platform that serves as the foundation for all Xsolla B2C products . Strong backend development skills in Go are essential, along with experience in building scalable distributed systems and working with authentication/authorization protocols . The ability to design and optimize high-availability services handling millions of users will be key to your success in this role. If you're passionate about creating reliable, secure identity solutions and love working on strategic platforms that directly impact user experience across gaming ecosystem , we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, China & APAC
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Product / Web Designer, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Product / Web Designer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working with our HQ Design team. This role is the design half of a two-person build pair: you and the Partnerships Backend Engineer take an inbound partnerships inquiry and turn it into something a player actually sees — a co-branded web shop, a campaign landing page, a creator or affiliate destination page — and ship it together. You will design conversion-oriented commerce surfaces for the Traffic Source Partners we onboard, adapt Xsolla and partner brand systems into one coherent look per campaign, and build a reusable component library so the next campaign launches faster than the last one. You will hand off to engineering with real specs and then review the implementation until it matches. This is an entry-level design role with a live audience. We care more about your portfolio and your eye than your years of experience — recent graduates and self-taught designers with strong work are welcome. If you like designing things that get measured, and you want to see your work convert real traffic in APAC markets, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Japan
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is detail-oriented, proactive, and highly collaborative to join our Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to design and build scalable backend systems, drive architectural improvements, and deliver resilient, high-performance services in production environments. Strong technical expertise in Go, distributed systems, and microservices architecture is essential, along with experience in building and operating cloud-native applications in containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes. The ability to troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize system performance, and manage event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar streaming platforms will be key to your success in this role. Notre usine de Longueuil est le berceau de BIXI, le premier système de vélopartage automatisé en Amérique du Nord, et fabrique aujourd'hui les vélos et les stations de certains des plus grands réseaux de vélopartage au monde. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye. Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other. You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month: Negotiation. Before booking, passengers can ask the driver for a detour, a lower price or another special request, and add a tip. Drivers accept, decline or make a counter-offer. It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out. Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards. GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others) Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature. Communication Service and contact preferences. The platform that sends every push notification, email, SMS and WhatsApp message across the company, plus the settings members use to choose what they receive. Marketing tools. jobs.description_text: Your Mission We're looking for a Brand Designer who lives and breathes design. Someone who evolves a brand with taste and restraint, obsesses over craft and detail, and never loses the idea underneath. You'll own brand design work end to end, from concept to pixel to motion, keeping BlaBlaCar's identity coherent, distinctive and alive as it scales. This isn't a ticket-executor role. Internal stakeholders: Growth Team, Local Markets (FR & BR), Product Design, Brand strategy, plus a pool of specialist freelancers. Evolve the brand system tastefully: extend and refine our visual language (type, colour, layout, illustration and motion) so it stays consistent and distinctive as it scales. jobs.description_text: If you're a driven sales professional with deep roots in the asset management sector and a passion for connecting clients to the data solutions they depend on, this is a rare opportunity to own and shape a high-growth territory across DACH and Central Europe. jobs.description_text: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it. This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show. What You'll Work On Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00. Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot. Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it. Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows. Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate. Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down. Who We're Looking For A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure. Your Background 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React. Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. What You'll Work On Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors. Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site. Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures. Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot. Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it. Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours. Who We're Looking For A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots. Your Background 3+ year

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A re

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.
